mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity; escitalopram inhibits serotonin reuptake while isocarboxazid inhibits monoamine oxidase, creating a serious risk for serotonin syndrome.
action: This combination is contraindicated; do not use together and allow at least 14 days washout of isocarboxazid before starting escitalopram, or 5 days washout of escitalopram before starting isocarboxazid.
